g.text: Each example becomes a test that must fail now. A test that passes already is vacuous and escalates.
Those test files are frozen. No later task may change them.
The implementer gets only its task, its examples, the glossary terms, the map and the charter.
The script runs the checks. Frozen tests untouched; earlier examples still pass.
Another model reviews scope, reuse and the ladder. Then the task is committed.
Green tests are not enough. The reviewer rejects a hand-made client.
The findings go back as feedback. Three tries, or the same failure twice, ends the task.
An ended task is reverted and listed. Independent tasks go on. The owner sees one list at the end.
